Sample.evidence_source: [/page/4/Text/7] This exploratory study was powered (80% power) to detect a large effect size (d> = 1.0), with a sample size of 15/group allowing up to 50% loss of participants at follow-up.

IPT.evidence_source: [/page/4/Text/7] Although all participants ultimately received SPARX, comparisons of changes from baseline to week 5 between the randomized groups were planned as the main analyses of efficacy. The comparison of 5-week and 10-week data for those who received SPARX first provided an estimate of the maintenance of changes. A further analysis tested whether changes associated with SPARX were the same for those who received it first compared with those who waited.
